exposure: prophylactic intraoperative bilateral uterine or internal iliac artery embolization
cohort: Patients with pernicious placenta previa in the third trimester of pregnancy
finding: Prophylactic intraoperative embolization of bilateral UAE or IIAE may be an effective strategy to treat intractable peripartum hemorrhage and preserve fertility in patients with pernicious placenta previa, though it may increase the risk of other complications.
mod_finding: The prophylactic intraoperative embolization of bilateral UAE or IIAE may be an effective strategy to treat intractable peripartum hemorrhage and preserve the fertility in patients with pernicious placenta previa.
